T1086.long: PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system.  Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code. Examples include the Start-Process cmdlet which can be used to run an executable and the Invoke-Command cmdlet which runs a command locally or on a remote computer.
